subject: Battlefield #18
text: Enemies in Battlefield #18 are very dangerous and attack first, so pull off attacks like White magic.

evidence.quote: -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- BATTLEFIELD #18 Location: East of Volcano Enemies: Iflyte, Stheno Reward: None Notes: These guys are very dangerous, so pull off attacks like White magic. The fact that they are all unprepared attacks, meaning they attack first, certainly does not help the situation.

subject: Focus Tower

evidence.quote: Location: FOCUS TOWER/DOOM CASTLE...B2: Get the Aero Spell.

subject: Giant's Axe
text: There is a Giant's Axe to the south in the center of the Alive Forest.

evidence.quote: Location: ALIVE FOREST...Just go to the center of the forest. There is a Giant's Axe to the south.

subject: Dragon Claw
text: Tristam will give you the Dragon Claw at Spencer's Place.

evidence.quote:
Go to Spencer's Place and talk to him.
Tristam will give you the Dragon Claw.

subject: Meteor Spell
text: On 2F of the Giant Tree, go down and to the right to get the Meteor Spell.

evidence.quote: Location: GIANT TREE...2F: Go down and to the right to get the Meteor Spell.

subject: Giant Tree
text: On 3F, go up using the claw, climb as far right as possible, release the A button and press it again really quickly twice, then go up to the door.

evidence.quote:
3F: Go up, using the claw, then climb as far right as possible. Now, release
the A button and press it again really quickly. Do the samw thing twice, then
go up to the door.

evidence.quote:
GIDRAH
Hit Points: 13,000
